hooks.prompt:
Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Take tool_input.file_path. If it doesn't end in .cs/.ts/.razor/.scss, reply exactly "No review needed." and stop.

Else read docs/CODING_STYLE.md and the file. List only style-guide violations as bullets citing file_path:line. Style only — no logic/naming/correctness. None → reply exactly "No style violations."
